name: Postwick Area
description: The green southern countryside where the journey begins, from the sheep pastures of Postwick and Wedgehurst to the mist-wrapped Slumbering Weald.

name: Wild Area
description: The vast open heartland of Galar, a sprawl of rolling fields, riverbanks, dusty basins and wind-swept lakes where almost anything can appear.

name: Motostoke Area
description: The soot-stained industrial belt around Motostoke, climbing from the steam-lit streets down into the coal seams of the Galar Mine.

name: Turffield Area
description: The farmland and geoglyph hills of Turffield running east to the harbour town of Hulbury and its seafood-rich coast.

name: Hammerlocke Area
description: The stone-walled dragon city of Hammerlocke and the rugged pass beyond it toward Stow-on-Side, cut through by Galar Mine No. 2.

name: Ballonlea Area
description: The hushed woodland south of Stow-on-Side, where the glowing fungi of Glimwood Tangle light the road to Ballonlea.

name: Circhester Area
description: The snowbound spa town of Circhester, its icy mountain approach along Steamdrift Way, and the cold bay below.

name: Wyndon Area
description: The final stretch north past Spikemuth's back alleys and over the frozen highlands into the capital, Wyndon.
